prediction_normalizer: Sector-method-sample pooled dynamic fitted-row mean, fixed across all prediction years. Saved residual_reference_mean, raw_log_residual, normalized_log_residual and normalized_residual_index.
index_definition: exp(centered log residual); geometric mean1 in the pooled dynamic fit group, not arithmetic mean1 or physical TFP; no multiplier100.
sector_universe: ALL and every reported sector across all supplied years; retain empty obligations.
quantiles: Stata summarize,detail empirical quantiles; independently validate using averaged inverse empirical CDF (NumPy averaged_inverted_cdf)

tail_rules.iqr: Within each named finite-measure group: Q1−1.5IQR/Q3+1.5IQR and Q1−3IQR/Q3+3IQR. Count strict violations, retain all observations; IQR0 allowed and flagged.

histograms.index: same width0.5 grid in centered-log coordinates; display boundaries exp(log_lower),exp(log_upper), geometric bins; shares always count/N, no kernel smoothing
histograms.paired_change: delta centered-log residual bins width0.25; exact positive/negative/zero counts
histograms.bootstrap: labor/capital bins width0.1; objective bins not pooled across methods; quantiles preserve all successful draws

suppression: Always report N and named denominators; with N<5 suppress exact numeric summaries/correlations/worked observed means. Fixed-bin counts and boundaries are aggregate categories; retain them. Never export obs_id or psid in publicCSV.
paired_design: Primary predictions on exact same fictional psid, sector, method and sample in adjacent calendar years. Never bridge2016. Year_from/year_to identify each interval;0/0 denotes pooled record-pair intervals, not unique companies. Coefficients and pooled fit normalizer are fixed across years.

worked_examples.observed_group_means: For each sector-method-year primary prediction group: mean(log VA)−betaL mean(log workers)−betaK mean(log beginning capital)=mean(raw residual). Center using the same pooled dynamic fit normalizer for every year. Mean(exp(centered)) generally differs from exp(mean(centered)).
worked_examples.hypothetical: Separate rows explicitly labelled illustrative_fixed_log_inputs use designed logs y=10,l=3,k=8 with actual reported slope and normalizer. No firm record is an example.

stages.N09: explicit sequential domain and calendar funnel
stages.N12: observed aggregate and designed arithmetic worked examples
stages.N13: existing fit sensitivity and bootstrap draw diagnostics

publication_scope: AggregateCSV only. Record-level intermediates remain in the new external diagnostics directory. Reuses coefficients from the new owner-authorized all-years capital-assumption run; original G0.5 source values remain unchanged.
pooled_rows: source_year0 is pooled across the defined prediction or fit sample; it is never a calendar year. Actual years retain explicit empty obligations.
